manifest.$comment: Codex's runtime loader is lenient (skills may be a path or an array, interface optional, hooks may be a path) but its publication validator is not — codex-rs/skills/src/assets/samples/plugin-creator/scripts/validate_plugin.py rejects the default manifest shape three ways: `skills` must be a single string normalising to the skills directory, `interface` is required in full, and the allowed key set is exactly id/name/version/description/skills/apps/mcpServers/interface/author/homepage/repository/license/keywords — `hooks` is not on it. Build against the validator, not the loader: a bundle that only satisfies the loader installs locally and fails publication.

skillPreamble: > **Codex path note.** Toolkit commands are written against `{{PLUGIN_ROOT}}`, which Codex does not set in your shell — it injects that variable into hook subprocesses only. Derive it from this skill's own `<path>`: the plugin root is the directory two levels above this `SKILL.md`. Export it once per session, before the first toolkit command you run, e.g. `export PLUGIN_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname <path to this SKILL.md>)/../.." && pwd)"`.
$skillPreambleComment: Verified against openai/codex codex-rs/hooks/src/engine/discovery.rs: PLUGIN_ROOT and CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT are injected into hook subprocesses and nowhere else, so hooks/hooks.json renders correctly but a skill body telling the model to run `${PLUGIN_ROOT}/lib/mp-cli.sh` expands to `/lib/mp-cli.sh` and every helper fails. Skills are presented to the model as <name>/<path>/<contents>, so the path is always available to derive from. Self-location inside core/lib cannot rescue this — it only starts helping once a script has actually been invoked.

mcp.$comment: Codex references an external .mcp.json from plugin.json via `mcpServers`. The file must be wrapped as {"mcpServers": {...}}: the loader also accepts a bare server map, but the publication validator rejects the unknown top-level keys that produces.

hooks.$comment: hooks/hooks.json is Codex's DEFAULT plugin hooks path (DEFAULT_HOOKS_CONFIG_FILE, codex-rs/core-plugins/src/loader.rs), so no manifestKey: the file is discovered where build.sh already writes it, and naming it would fail the publication validator's allowed key set. Wire format is identical to Claude Code's — verified against codex-rs/hooks/schema/generated/pre-tool-use.command.{input,output}.schema.json and codex-rs/config/src/hooks_tests.rs — including permissionDecision, whose enum is allow|deny|ask.

marketplace.$comment: Codex reads marketplaces from .agents/plugins/marketplace.json with a structured source object.
